description: session-objective: one objective file per session. [UserPromptSubmit] append the operator's message to the append-only ledger verbatim, reset STATUS to ACTIVE, inject the file and the rewrite instruction || [PreToolUse, every tool] deny every tool call until the OBJECTIVE layer is bound to the latest ledger entry, except the Write that rewrites it; deny any change to the ledger or to the objective home by any other path; deny an objective rewrite that drops a CONSTRAINT or a REJECTED INTERPRETATION without a SUPERSEDED line || [Stop] refuse to end a turn while STATUS is ACTIVE (bounded at 3 denials), refuse a NEEDS-DECISION whose question was never asked, and refuse a COMPLETE whose PROOF commands do not reproduce their recorded exit codes || [SessionStart] re-inject the file on startup, resume and compact; archive it and start empty on clear || [SubagentStart] seed the subagent's own file from the parent's OBJECTIVE layer with an empty ledger, and inject it
